findings.claim: Эксперименты: «В программе конференции указаны другие значения: 10,32% и 11,64%. ... отличаются версия описания и определение измеряемого показателя»; question1 treats10.32% as CTR directly requiring reconciliation with0.78%.
findings.evidence: Same cached arXiv:2608.24176v1, §3.6.3 and Table6:10.32% and11.64% are single-domain pathway UCTR relative improvements (Overall/New Item). Pathway CTR values are4.79%/8.46%. The same section separately reports full A/B 24-hour overall/newly-published picture CTR +0.78%/+1.94%; cross-domain per-capita picture CTR +1.05%. Abstract also contains10.32%/11.64%. Thus the numerical difference is explained by metric and scope inside the same version, not evidenced by a changed version.
findings.correction: Replace version-change explanation with explicit distinction: «Table6 показывает UCTR дополнительного retrieval-канала +10,32% по всему набору и +11,64% по новым item; общие24-часовые CTR в A/B растут на0,78%/1,94%. Это разные области измерения и метрики одной версии». Reword author question1 toward how pathway UCTR uplift translates into overall A/B uplift, without labeling10.32% as globalCTR.
findings.resolution: Separated retrieval-pathway UCTR from full-platform 24-hour CTR; removed unsupported version-change explanation; updated question1.
